headline: Prime SE swell to 4ft, offshore and clean all day — the day of the week.
today: This is the standout: prime SE angle, size pushing 4ft with some longer-period lines in the mix at 6.6s, and offshore NNE grooming it dawn to dusk. Clean, sizeable, and on the right direction — everything you drive 3 hours for. Shortboard or fish, work the incoming to the 3:24p high. If you can only make one trip this week, make it today.

daysToWatch.note: A long-period line (up to 9.4s) shows early with cross-off ENE wind at dawn — worth watching for a clean small window before it goes onshore SW.
Biggest raw size of the back half at 3ft-plus, but SW cross-on builds to 18mph and junks it up. Dawn only, and even then it's fair angle.
